controls.name: Portable regression lane

controls.mechanism: The existing tools/check.py runner executes syntax, selected Ruff, Import Linter, document metadata/local links, governance structure and whitespace. Local --fast stops there with calendar-only warnings. Strict full/editorial/viewer/main-smoke profiles also render diagrams and enforce current-date governance. Full collects existing unittest cases through pinned pytest with four pytest-xdist processes, built-in work stealing and 20 slowest durations; component profiles run explicit consumer/boundary tests grouped by file; main-smoke runs fixed selected cases serially. Every behavioral profile runs the Node viewer suite; editorial omits behavioral/viewer tests. tools/ci.py owns the shared explicit scope/test manifest and chooses from complete native Git diffs and existing GitHub PR/run/job facts under docs/project-management.md#protected-ci-profiles; unknown/nonregular eligibility selects full. docs/testing.md maps responsibilities, useful overlap and duplication review. Worker/check failures propagate without restart, ignored failures or cached green results. Focused development tests remain selected by the lead. Portable fixtures do not qualify gameplay or browser layout. Native pytest strict marker registration rejects undeclared metadata; the representative assurance groups in docs/testing.md support navigation/focused development, not production profile routing or semantic-coverage claims.
controls.trigger: Fast structural checks on each configured local commit; focused tests on affected behavior; appropriate strict profile at coherent integration/formal acceptance and main-targeting PR/main CI events; broad source changes require full regression before merge
controls.failure_response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.
controls.limitations: Fast mode omits behavioral tests, viewer regressions and rendered diagrams. Editorial omits runtime/viewer tests; viewer covers explicit consumers and boundary smoke rather than full regression or browser layout; main-smoke does not rerun full regression and depends on qualifying linked PR coverage. Reduced scopes are not full portable passes. Focused selection and prose truth require judgment. Synthetic fixtures do not execute CDDA or prove host schema/image loading, review-free gameplay, fresh context, cross-game support or useful cadence. Link checks validate current Markdown fragments, but omit historical-origin fragment targets, external availability and raw HTML; Ruff is a selected diagnostic set, not full typing/formatting. Missing tools or denied loopback/browser access fail the affected lane. A started/cancelled check is not a pass.
controls.enforcement: Opt-in project-local pre-commit hook runs --fast. The always-present Actions controller selects a strict profile for PRs explicitly targeting main and pushes to main; no workflow path filters or ignored failures. Logs/Actions summary state profile/reason and qualifying PR coverage for main-smoke. Covered documentation and explicit viewer boundaries receive their declared strict scopes; cross-cutting, validation and unknown PR changes receive full. Changed validation machinery/context also forces full on main. GitHub concurrency cancels superseded PR runs only. Main retains strict Actions-app15368 controller requirement under ruleset25346774. Hooks remain bypassable. Hosted activation evidence must be recorded in the issue/PR after actual execution; this definition is not a hosted pass.
